# Palma Real Estate Office

> This is a corporate office for Palma Real Estate, a Dubai property firm whose work spans development, sales, leasing and property management. The premises sit within an office tower in Dubai Marina, the high-density waterfront district built around an artificial canal on the city's southern shore. The setting places the office among the residential and commercial towers that line the marina promenade.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Marina, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Palma Real Estate is a long-established Dubai property company whose business spans development, sales, leasing and property management. MENASCO carried out the electrical and mechanical works for the company's office in Dubai Marina, working as a subcontractor to the fit-out contractor. The project adds a corporate office fit-out to MENASCO's portfolio of commercial interiors in Dubai.
